newsitem.title: JAPAN: NEC receives PHS wireless loop order from Uruguay.
newsitem.headline: NEC receives PHS wireless loop order from Uruguay.

text.p: NEC Corp said on Friday its affiliate had received an order for a Personal Handyphone System-based wireless local loop (WLL) from Uruguay's national telecommunications provider, ANTEL (Administracion Nacional de Telecommunicaiones).
The order is for 43,000 lines and 578 cell stations based on the PHS standard, and the first 19,000 lines will be ready for service this February, it said in a statement.
An NEC spokesman declined to give the value of the order.
NEC said its local affiliate, NEC do Brasil S.A., had won the order.
The dealis NEC's first WLL project in Uruguay and fourth in Latin America following earlier orders from Guatemala, Argentina and Columbia.
